title: Chocolate Mousse
description: Heston Blumenthal-inspired waterganache mousse — chocolate melted with water, then whisked over ice until light and creamy. No cream, no eggs.
steps: Roughly chop the chocolate (holding a few chunks back). Place in a saucepan with the water and heat until melted.
Make a cold bath by filling a large bowl with cold water (and ice if available). Place a smaller bowl inside.
Pour the melted chocolate mixture into the smaller bowl. Whisk with an electric whisk on high for around 15 minutes until pale and creamy and a dollop sits on the surface without sinking.
Spoon into ramekins and smooth the tops with a wet spoon.
Top with raspberries and remaining chocolate chunks.
notes: Makes 6 mini mousses. Can be eaten immediately or chilled. Add a few shakes of dried chilli to the melted chocolate for a spicy kick.
